__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The little tyke looks so innocent playing with his boomerang that you
just want to pick him up and hug him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A gnome child is playing around here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle child gnome

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The woman is short and gnarled, but acts like a woman several times her beauty.
She's starting to look pretty attractive to you ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A gnome woman is standing here, trying to look beautiful.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle woman gnome

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is a prime example of a gnome.  He looks short and weak, but at the
same time an intelligent creature who could outsmart you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A gnome man is walking here, on his way to work.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle man gnome

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a gnome who is lost deep into some invention that he is about
to make.  His hair is white, but he looks fairly strong.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A scientist wanders around deep in thought.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle scientist gnome

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is a well trained gnome.  He might not have a lot of strength but
he makes up for it with his weapons skill.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A gnome guard stands here guarding something.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guard gnome

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The Chief looks like he could whap you hard.  He looks not only powerful
but wise and resourceful.  You better not mess with him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A powerful looking gnome stands here wearing ornate clothes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chief gnome

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The small troll is a short and stocky beast with a human-like face
but with the eyes and fangs of a wild beast.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small troll grunts as he takes a swing at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle troll small

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The Mouse is a cute little creature.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small mouse runs across your foot.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mouse field

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The rat is a little evil creature that deserves death.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small rat shrieks and runs around.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle rat

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You have the urge to kill this vile creature.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large rat runs up to you and nibbles on your boots.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle rat large

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This rat has grown up to be the size of an average dog.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A giant rat growls at you and prepares to attack.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle rat giant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see before you a huge mass of living flesh.  You cringe in fear as
he lifts his powerful arm to bludgeon you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A giant troll lumbers around.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle troll

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The bat is a grotesque little creature with large wings and fangs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A black bat hangs from the ceiling.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bat black

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is a creature which has passed away long ago.  His body has been
pulled out of its resting place by some evil force.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A zombie gnome shuffles his way towards you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle zombie gnome

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a huge flame which resembles the shape of a bat.  The creature
hangs from the ceiling and bites at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The fire bat flames brightly and prepares to attack.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bat fire

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is an extra large, extra ugly goblin like creature.  He grins evilly
as he attempts to brain you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The hobgoblin guard attacks first, thinks later.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guard hobgoblin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is just a low life hobgoblin, who couldn't make it to the ranks
of the elite guards.  He looks pissed.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hobgoblin soldier stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle soldier hobgoblin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is one of the elite hobgoblin guards.  He stands tall for his short
stature.  He grins a toothy grin as he prepares to attack.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hobgoblin bodyguard guards the king with his life.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bodyguard hobgoblin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The king is a silly looking hobgoblin whose muscles bulge out of his robes,
destroying the sophisticated effect he was trying to create.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: There is a great king here, sitting in his throne.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle king hobgoblin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The miner is totally covered in dust.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hobgoblin miner stands here looking for gold.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle miner hobgoblin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The hobgoblin treasurer is an old goblin with glasses.  It appears that he
can only see a couple feet in front of him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A treasurer is here counting out money.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle treasurer hobgoblin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The prisoner is just barely alive.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A gnome prisoner is here resting in the straw.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle prisoner gnome

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The prisoner is just barely alive.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A human prisoner is here resting in the straw.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle prisoner human

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The hermit crab is about 5 feet high and looks mad that you had the nerve
to wake it up.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hermit crab crawls towards you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hermit crab

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The cook is a dirty and fat hobgoblin.  He burps as he stirs up something
in a pot.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hobgoblin cook stands here cooking something.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cook hobgoblin
